title: How to Write Resume Bullets That Get You Hired
description:
If your resume is just a list of responsibilities… you’re missing the most important part.  Hiring managers want to see accomplishments—not tasks. In this video, I’ll teach you how to turn boring job duties into impactful, results-driven resume bullets that actually impress recruiters and pass ATS scans. You’ll learn my easy formula for writing achievements, even if you don’t have access to exact metrics or data. Whether you're in tech, marketing, admin, or customer service—this works for every job, every resume.
